        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const TableOfContents = memo(\n  ( { editor, onItemClick }: TableOfContentsProps ) =\u003e {\n    const [data, setData] = useState\u003cTableOfContentsStorage | null\u003e( null )\n\n    useEffect( () =\u003e {\n      const handler = ( { editor: currentEditor }: { editor: CoreEditor } ) =\u003e {\n        setData( { ...currentEditor.extensionStorage.tableOfContents } )\n      }\n\n      handler( { editor } )\n\n      editor.on( 'update', handler )\n      editor.on( 'selectionUpdate', handler )\n\n      return () =\u003e {\n        editor.off( 'update', handler )\n        editor.off( 'selectionUpdate', handler )\n      }\n    }, [editor] )\n\n    return (\n      \u003c\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className='mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-400'\u003e\n          Table of contents\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        {data \u0026\u0026 data.content.length \u003e 0 ? (\n          \u003cdiv className='flex flex-col gap-1'\u003e\n            {data.content.map( ( item ) =\u003e (\n              \u003ca\n                key={item.id}\n                href={&#96;#${item.id}&#96;}\n                style={{ marginLeft: &#96;${1 * item.level - 1}rem&#96; }}\n                onClick={onItemClick}\n                className={cn(\n                  'block font-medium text-neutral-500 dark:text-neutral-300 p-1 rounded bg-opacity-10 text-sm hover:text-neutral-800 transition-all hover:bg-black hover:bg-opacity-5 truncate w-full',\n                  item.isActive \u0026\u0026\n                  'text-neutral-800 bg-neutral-100 dark:text-neutral-100 dark:bg-neutral-900'\n                )}\n              \u003e\n                {item.itemIndex}. {item.textContent}\n              \u003c/a\u003e\n            ) )}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003cdiv className='text-sm text-neutral-500'\u003e\n            Start adding headlines to your document …\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/\u003e\n    )\n  }\n)",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function MindMapSideMenu() {\n  const {\n    showLocationVisualization,\n    locationsToVisualize,\n    toggleLocationVisualization,\n    conciseViewActive,\n    toggleConciseView,\n    saveMindMap,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  const [bookmarked, setBookmarked] = useState(false)\n  const [noteTitle, setNoteTitle] = useState('')\n  const [note, setNote] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n\n  const saveNote = async () =\u003e {\n    setBookmarked(true)\n    // const model = objectMapToSingular[card?.type]\n\n    const saved = await saveEventForUser({\n      user,\n      event: {id: null},\n      userNote: {title: noteTitle, content: note},\n      theory: 'test',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const updateNote = ({target: {value}}: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLTextAreaElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    setNote(value)\n  }\n\n  const userAuth = useAuth()\n  const user = userAuth?.userId ? userAuth : null\n\n  const [isConcise, setIsConcise] = useState(conciseViewActive)\n  const pressed = isConcise\n    ? {\n        color: 'rgb(244 244 245 / var(--tw-text-opacity))',\n        backgroundColor: 'rgb(75 85 99 / var(--tw-bg-opacity))',\n      }\n    : {}\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    setIsConcise(conciseViewActive)\n  }, [conciseViewActive])\n\n  const handleSavingNote = () =\u003e {\n    saveNote()\n  }\n\n  const handleSubmit = () =\u003e {\n    handleSavingNote()\n  }\n  const [crossed, setCrossed] = useState(false)\n  const handleClick = () =\u003e {\n    setCrossed(!crossed)\n  }",

        "contents": "import { Node } from '@tiptap/pm/model'\nimport { NodeSelection } from '@tiptap/pm/state'\nimport { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { useCallback } from 'react'\n\nconst useContentItemActions = (\n  editor: Editor,\n  currentNode: Node | null,\n  currentNodePos: number\n) =\u003e {\n  const resetTextFormatting = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    const chain = editor.chain()\n\n    chain.setNodeSelection(currentNodePos).unsetAllMarks()\n\n    if (currentNode?.type.name !== 'paragraph') {\n      chain.setParagraph()\n    }\n\n    chain.run()\n  }, [editor, currentNodePos, currentNode?.type.name])\n\n  const duplicateNode = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    editor.commands.setNodeSelection(currentNodePos)\n\n    const { $anchor } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedNode =\n      $anchor.node(1) || (editor.state.selection as NodeSelection).node\n\n    editor\n      .chain()\n      .setMeta('hideDragHandle', true)\n      .insertContentAt(\n        currentNodePos + (currentNode?.nodeSize || 0),\n        selectedNode.toJSON()\n      )\n      .run()\n  }, [editor, currentNodePos, currentNode?.nodeSize])\n\n  const copyNodeToClipboard = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    editor\n      .chain()\n      .setMeta('hideDragHandle', true)\n      .setNodeSelection(currentNodePos)\n      .run()\n\n    document.execCommand('copy')\n  }, [editor, currentNodePos])\n\n  const deleteNode = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    editor\n      .chain()\n      .setMeta('hideDragHandle', true)\n      .setNodeSelection(currentNodePos)\n      .deleteSelection()\n      .run()\n  }, [editor, currentNodePos])",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const MindMapBottomMenu = () =\u003e {\n  // Get session ID for the current user/session\n  const sessionId = useRef\u003cstring\u003e(\n    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sessionId') || uuidv4() : uuidv4()\n  )\n\n  // Store session ID in localStorage if it's new\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' \u0026\u0026 !localStorage.getItem('sessionId')) {\n      localStorage.setItem('sessionId', sessionId.current)\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  const {\n    status: chatStatus,\n    messages,\n    input,\n    setInput,\n    submitMessage,\n    handleInputChange,\n    append,\n    error,\n  } = useAssistant({\n    api: '/api/disclosure/chat',\n    headers: {\n      'x-session-id': sessionId.current,\n    },\n  })\n\n  // Save messages to localStorage when they change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (messages.length \u003e 0 \u0026\u0026 typeof window !== 'undefined') {\n      localStorage.setItem('chatMessages', JSON.stringify(messages))\n    }\n  }, [messages])\n\n  // Handle assistant errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Assistant error:', error)\n      // Display error to user - could use a toast library here\n    }\n  }, [error])\n\n  const {\n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    loadNodesFromTableQuery,\n    addConnectionNodesFromSearch,\n    addUserInputNode,\n    addNodes,\n    updateNodeData,\n    addEdges,\n    screenToFlowPosition,\n    retrieveEntitiesFromStore,\n\n    setEdges,\n    setNodes,\n    getNodes,\n    addNode,\n\n    getNode,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  const idCounter = useRef(0)\n  const getNextId = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    idCounter.current += 1\n    return &#96;userInputNode-${idCounter.current}&#96;\n  }, [])\n\n  const calculateCenterOfScreen = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return {x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2}\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\n\nexport const getRenderContainer = (editor: Editor, nodeType: string) =\u003e {\n  const {\n    view,\n    state: {\n      selection: { from },\n    },\n  } = editor\n\n  const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.has-focus')\n  const elementCount = elements.length\n  const innermostNode = elements[elementCount - 1]\n  const element = innermostNode\n\n  if (\n    (element \u0026\u0026 element.getAttribute('data-type') \u0026\u0026 element.getAttribute('data-type') === nodeType) ||\n    (element \u0026\u0026 element.classList \u0026\u0026 element.classList.contains(nodeType))\n  ) {\n    return element\n  }\n\n  const node = view.domAtPos(from).node as HTMLElement\n  let container: HTMLElement | null = node\n\n  if (!container.tagName) {\n    container = node.parentElement\n  }\n\n  while (\n    container \u0026\u0026\n    !(container.getAttribute('data-type') \u0026\u0026 container.getAttribute('data-type') === nodeType) \u0026\u0026\n    !container.classList.contains(nodeType)\n  ) {\n    container = container.parentElement\n  }\n\n  return container\n}",

        "originalContents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\n\nexport const getRenderContainer = (editor: Editor, nodeType: string) =\u003e {\n  const {\n    view,\n    state: {\n      selection: { from },\n    },\n  } = editor\n\n  const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.has-focus')\n  const elementCount = elements.length\n  const innermostNode = elements[elementCount - 1]\n  const element = innermostNode\n\n  if (\n    (element \u0026\u0026 element.getAttribute('data-type') \u0026\u0026 element.getAttribute('data-type') === nodeType) ||\n    (element \u0026\u0026 element.classList \u0026\u0026 element.classList.contains(nodeType))\n  ) {\n    return element\n  }\n\n  const node = view.domAtPos(from).node as HTMLElement\n  let container: HTMLElement | null = node\n\n  if (!container.tagName) {\n    container = node.parentElement\n  }\n\n  while (\n    container \u0026\u0026\n    !(container.getAttribute('data-type') \u0026\u0026 container.getAttribute('data-type') === nodeType) \u0026\u0026\n    !container.classList.contains(nodeType)\n  ) {\n    container = container.parentElement\n  }\n\n  return container\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ENC = memo( ( node: any ) =\u003e {\n  const { useUpdateNodeInternals, useNodesData } = useMindMap()\n  const updateNodeInternals = useUpdateNodeInternals()\n  const [handles, setHandles]: any = useState( [] )\n  const nodeData = useNodesData( node.id )\n\n  useEffect( () =\u003e {\n    if ( node?.data?.handles \u0026\u0026 node.data?.handles.length ) {\n      const { data } = node\n\n      setHandles( data.handles )\n      updateNodeInternals( node.id )\n    }\n\n    // if (node?.data?.concise) {\n    //   updateNodeInternals(node.id)\n    // }\n  }, [node, updateNodeInternals, nodeData] )\n\n  const component = renderEntity( {\n    type: node.data.type,\n    data: {\n      ...node.data,\n      id: node.id,\n    },\n  } )\n\n\n\n  const markUp = (\n    \u003cBlurAppear\n      className={&#96;rounded-[calc(var(--radius)-2px)] relative h-auto ${node.parentId} ${node.className} w-full&#96;}\n    \u003e\n      {handles \u0026\u0026 handles?.length\n        ? handles.map( ( id: string ) =\u003e (\n          \u003cHandle\n            key={id}\n            type='source'\n            position={Position.Bottom}\n            id={id}\n            isConnectable={true}\n          /\u003e\n        ) )\n        : null}\n      \u003cHandle type='target' position={Position.Top} /\u003e\n\n      {component}\n    \u003c/BlurAppear\u003e\n  )\n\n  // if (domNode) {\n  //   return createPortal(markUp, domNode)\n  // }\n\n  return markUp\n} )\n\nexport const EntityGroupNodeChild = memo( ENC )",

I've updated the MindMapMessages component to properly handle the messages prop and render them. The changes include:

1. Added necessary imports for useRef, cn utility function, and MarkdownContent component
2. Defined TypeScript interfaces for Message and MessagePart
3. Created a props interface for the component
4. Implemented the renderMessagePart function to handle different types of message parts:

   - Reasoning blocks with markdown
   - Tool invocation details
   - File attachments (with special handling for images)
5. Added a ref for the messages container for potential scrolling functionality

The component now properly accepts a messages array as a prop and renders them with appropriate styling based on whether they are user or assistant messages. It also handles complex message structures with multiple parts of different types.
